page.overview:
What is Cthulhu's aliases?

The Great Old One known as Cthulhu has gone by many names since its first appearance in the 1928 short story "The Call of Cthulhu", published by the Weird Tales magazine. While many of these are undoubtedly little more than alternate spellings for a name never intended to have been uttered by human vocal chords, a sizeable portion are entirely new monikers. This page offers a guide to the many and varied names of Cthulhu, arguably the most iconic of H. P. Lovecraft's creations, and includes the avatars employed by this eldritch abomination.
